node.statement: Substitution of definitions: by the definitions in the root statement, sum_i beta_i^+*max(R_i,0)=I_{r,j}(U), sum_i beta_i^+*a_s(i)^-=B_{r,s}, sum_i beta_i^+*a_s(i)^+=A_{r,s}, alpha=(max(1-c,0)+max(-d_t,0)+max(d_r,0))/c, and gamma=(max(d_t,0)+max(-d_r,0))/c; substituting these identities is exactly the asserted inequality.
